title: Canonical object Gaussians with SE3 Mirror motion code
hypothesis: One canonical point cloud plus a compact valid SE(3) motion code reconstructs unseen action compositions with materially fewer serialized bytes than storing each posed point cloud; Mirror-specific value requires an advantage over native SE(3) pose parameters with the same decoder.
physical_object: Canonical point-cloud geometry for each rigid object
mirror_coordinate: SE(3) rigid pose matrix code m composed from action transforms
logical_multiplicity: Object poses produced from held-out two-action compositions without duplicating geometry
controls_required: Independent posed point-cloud bank for every logical object/action view
Native SE(3) matrix pose parameters plus shared canonical geometry
Mirror-addressed SE(3) motion code plus shared canonical geometry

data_generation.heldout_compositions: All ordered action pairs; transforms are composed in SE(3), not added in Euclidean coordinates

storage.authority: Actual compressed NPZ serialized inference payload bytes
paid_objects: all independent posed point clouds in upper control

report: SE(3) composition plus point transform MAC proxy
CPU replay wall time as descriptive only

quality.metric: Maximum and RMS pointwise Euclidean error against direct SE(3) action composition
quality.validity: Rotation orthogonality, determinant, and homogeneous last row
quality.success_gate: All fresh worlds have max error <=1e-5 and at least 50% fewer bytes than independent posed point clouds
quality.mirror_specific_gate: Mirror payload/output/compute must improve over native SE(3) control; exact aliases fail attribution

boundaries: Synthetic rigid point geometry only; no MRO-GWM training, real object interaction, camera rendering, occlusion, or rollout PSNR claim.
The native SE(3) control uses identical pose matrices and decoder; exact alias is expected and tests Mirror attribution.
SE(3) action composition is not evidence of learned action-conditioned dynamics.

Amendment 01 corrects the native SE(3) control to use the same six primitive transforms and shared decoder as Mirror; preliminary pose-table-control fresh set 90321/90323/90329 is archived and excluded.
notes: Amendment 01: native control stores the same primitive SE(3) transforms and decoder, so its payload must byte-alias Mirror; new fresh seeds replace initially evaluated set.

facts: Fresh canonical+SE3 payload: 12,348–12,372 B; fully materialized posed point clouds: 409,738–410,119 B (~96.98% reduction).
All heldout action compositions have exactly zero pointwise decode error in synthetic geometry.
Corrected native SE3 payload and outputs exactly equal Mirror in all fresh seeds.
Shared transform compute proxy is 1728 MAC; independent cached point-cloud lookup is 0 transform MAC.
decision.interpretation: Synthetic rigid-geometry storage mechanism passes, but it exactly aliases ordinary native SE3 instancing; FAIL Mirror-specific attribution.
decision.hypothesis: Real action-conditioned dynamics and nonrigid/appearance states remain untested.
